title: SPARK: Self-Correcting Embodied Memory via Physical Re-Observation
abstract: arXiv:2611.00344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have seen growing adoption in embodied settings as language-queryable memories of the environment. However, existing approaches often assume a reliable single-episode knowledge base (KB) or accumulate observations across episodes without correcting prior errors. Such errors can persist through incorrect semantic labels, inaccurate object positions, and inconsistent spatial relationships. To address this, we present SPARK, a corrective multi-episode framework for embodied RAG. After the first episode, a semantic critic flags regions of the KB, a targeted planner generates revisits, and a selective merge adds, removes, or replaces KB information based on the new observations. We evaluate SPARK on four outdoor AirSim maps under two degraded viewpoint conditions, using perception-built KBs, a visibility-constrained oracle used only for evaluation, and a fixed set of 158 embodied question answeri

translated_title: SPARK：通过物理重观测实现自我纠正的具身记忆
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统作为可被语言查询的环境记忆，在具身场景中的应用日益增多。然而，现有方法通常假设存在可靠的单次任务知识库（KB），或者跨任务累积观测而不纠正先前的错误。此类错误可能以错误的语义标签、不准确的对象位置和不一致的空间关系等形式持续存在。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SPARK，一个用于具身RAG的纠正性多任务框架。在第一次任务结束后，语义批评器（semantic critic）标记知识库中存在问题的区域，针对性规划器生成重访计划，选择性合并模块则根据新的观测结果对知识库信息进行添加、删除或替换。我们在四张户外AirSim地图上，在两种退化视角条件下对SPARK进行评估，使用由感知构建的知识库、仅用于评估的可见性受限参考基准，以及固定的158个具身问答数据集。
tldr: 提出了SPARK框架，通过语义批评器标记知识库错误、针对性规划器生成重访计划、选择性合并更新信息，实现具身RAG记忆的自我纠错。
